correctness.rationale: For \(F=e_3\) in characteristic two, a linear transformation yields \(UVT+W^2(U+V+T)\); exact derivative and cleared-denominator identities are checked by verify.py. The odd y=0 valuation shows projection has degree 2, while \(r=G_1/G_2\) and \(t=G_3/G_2\) give \(y=r+tz\) and \(z^2=r(r+1)/(t(t+1))\), a second degree-2 purely inseparable extension. All y²,z²,w² lie in \(K=k(r,t)\); \(k(X)/k(X)^2\) has degree four for a perfect base and dimension two; hence K=\(k(X)^2\). Rank-seven cubic evaluation, local rank-two at every Fano base point, and intersection (3H-ΣE)²=2 prove the anticanonical factor. Generic assumptions and exclusion of exceptional fibers are explicit.

value.rationale: The intrinsic dual variety of the standard four-nodal cubic drops from a classical Steiner quartic to a linear plane in characteristic two; the Gauss map simultaneously becomes an exponent-one purely inseparable extension of degree four. Factoring it through the net of cubics based at seven Fano-plane points gives a natural and structurally meaningful explanation, not a textbook restatement of the reduced singular locus or an arbitrary parameter slice.
